name: HC11b : Active on ART on 2nd-line ARV regimen
description: Counts unique active ART patients whose latest consolidated regimen information classifies them as being on a second-line ARV regimen, using the standard active-on-ART definition.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen",
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.regimen_line IN (
    'SECOND LINE ARV REGIMEN'
)
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );",

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.regimen_line IN (
    'SECOND LINE ARV REGIMEN'
)
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
